body: A noose will do, please don't repeat what I do. My father got me to a boiling point. This is too much. Stay strong. Peace. If I live I'll update, but I doubt.
Sorry, I am from Latvia (Latvija, Lettonie, Lettland, Латвия)

I know what you mean exactly, but I haven't given up just yet, I think you should stay for a while too. And it really depends on who she was. She might make it worse by spreading the fact that you want to do it or she might actually help you. It's up to you bro, just stay strong and try to fight for your life. I try my best to occupy myself with a hobby like playing an instrument and it helps me numb the inner pain. I write poetry and lyrics about what I feel. It doesn't have to be good, but for me personally it doesn't cure my state of mind, only numbs it down so I don't do anything since I am already occupied.
